# Viaggio — journey snapshot import (for LLM / integrator agents)

Purpose: generate a JSON file a signed-in user can import into Viaggio to create
a new journey, or to replace the timeline of an existing journey via the in-app
AI planner Import flow.

## Format

- format (required): "viaggio.journey_snapshot"
- version (required): 1
- journey (required object)
- people (required array, at least one person)
- Optional arrays: contacts, entries, entry_participants, expenses,
  expense_splits, playlist, place_ideas, todos
- exported_at (optional ISO-8601)

## Machine-readable contract

- JSON Schema: https://project-viaggio.web.app/agent/import.schema.json
- Sample JSON: https://project-viaggio.web.app/agent/sample.json
- Human spec (repo): docs/journey-snapshot.md

## How users import (new journey)

1. Sign in at https://project-viaggio.web.app
2. Archives → Import JSON, or use Journey Settings export/import flows
3. Select the generated .json file

## External edit loop (update an existing journey)

Typical ChatGPT / Copilot round-trip:

1. Open the journey → AI planner → **Export** (downloads current snapshot JSON)
2. Optionally use **Copy prompt** in the AI planner for instructions
3. Attach/paste the JSON in ChatGPT/Copilot and request edits
4. Return a complete `viaggio.journey_snapshot` JSON file
5. In the same AI planner → **Import** → review → confirm replace timeline

Import on an existing journey **replaces** activities, todos, place ideas,
playlist, and expenses. **Members and people seats stay.**

Broken JSON may be sanitized client-side and optionally repaired with Viaggio’s
in-app AI before the user confirms apply.

## In-app planner

Viaggio’s AI planner chat can also propose add/update actions without files
(Accept / Reject). New journeys can still be created via New journey → Plan
with AI, or Archives → Import JSON.

## Import rules agents must respect

- All ids in the file are opaque local strings for cross-references only;
  Viaggio remaps them to new UUIDs on import (except when updating existing
  entries via in-app chat actions that carry live entry ids).
- journey.type: "trip" | "journal"
- journey.preset: catalog id (e.g. leisure_trip, road_trip)
- journey.default_timezone: IANA (e.g. Europe/Lisbon) — plain string only
- journey.default_currency: ISO 4217 uppercase (e.g. EUR)
- journey.starts_on / ends_on: YYYY-MM-DD only (never concatenated schema paths)
- entries[].activity_id must be a known catalog activity (flight, hotel, meal,
  sightseeing, ferry, train, …); unknown activities fail import.
- entries[].details is an object whose keys depend on activity_id (catalog
  detailHints). Fill when visible on bookings or user text — do not leave
  airports / confirmation numbers only in title.
  - flight: airline, flight_number, confirmation, from, to (IATA preferred)
  - train | ferry | boat | drive_leg: from, to (+ confirmation / vessel / provider as listed)
  - hotel | lodging: confirmation; also place_name + ends_at_local for checkout
  - car_rental: provider, confirmation, pickup_location, dropoff_location
  - restaurant: reservation
  - rideshare | appointment | doctor_visit | dentist | contractor: provider (+ confirmation where applicable)
  - fuel | car_service | car_repair: shop / odometer / gallons_or_liters as applicable
  - chore: assignee; bill: due_date; game: opponent, home_away
- Prefer occurs_at_local / ends_at_local as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" plus IANA
  timezone(s). App converts to UTC. Do not encode local wall clock as …Z.
- Lodging/hotel: check-in + check-out on the same entry (ends_at_local required).
  Never invent a separate “checkout” activity.
- Transit/rental across zones: set start_timezone and end_timezone.
- Participants: entry_participants[{entry_id, person_id}] and/or
  entries[].participant_ids referencing people[].id.
- expenses: 0–N activities via entry_ids (empty = journey-level expense).
  Optional entry_id is primary when linked. Legacy files with only entry_id
  still import.
- place_ideas need name + approximate lat/lng when suggesting map pins.
- Playlist: prefer { title, search_query? } without inventing stream URLs.
- Never emit values like `Scope.ends_on:…` or mashed timezone/address strings.
- Signed-in importer becomes the new journey owner on create-via-import.

## Do not include

Auth users, passwords, invite tokens, binary attachments.
